title: Flat K-flat representative scalar/pullback tensor equation
statement: For commutative rings A and B, a unital map φ : A →+* B, a morphism f : X ⟶ Y of schemes, and flat-term K-flat complexes P and R of A-valued etale sheaves on Y, the normalized scalar/pullback tensor composite on DerivedCategory.Q.obj P and DerivedCategory.Q.obj R equals the composite through the B-valued tensor comparison and the tensor of the scalar/pullback maps.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 0GL6; flat representative tensor calculation

proof.text: Evaluate both composites on homogeneous local pure tensors. The scalar/pullback representative square and the scalar and geometric pullback tensor squares send ((p tensor q) tensor b) to (f*p tensor b) tensor (f*q tensor 1). The balancing relation moves b between the factors, while the total-complex differential and Koszul signs agree term by term. Sheafification preserves the equality, proving the representative morphisms agree.

theorem etaleScalarPullback_tensor_kFlat
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P R : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ)
    (_hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (_hR : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat R)
    (_hPflat : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X n))
    (_hRflat : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (R.X n)) :
    (scalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj R) ≫
      (scalarExtension φ X).map
        (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj R)) ≫
      (ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ X).hom.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
          (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj R)) =
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        ((ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ Y).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj R)) ≫
      (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).app
        ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))).app
          ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj R))) ≫
      ((scalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⊗ₘ
        (scalarPullbackIso φ f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj R))
